environment.problem: GPU solves were blocked by two independent faults.
environment.fault_1: The system CUDA toolkit is 13.3, whose nvcc lists only compute_100/103/110/120/121 (Blackwell). The GPU is an RTX 4090 Laptop with compute capability 8.9 (Ada), so -arch sm_89 was rejected before any field array was allocated.
environment.fault_2: nvcc also needs the MSVC host compiler. Without cl.exe it stops with "Cannot find compiler 'cl.exe' in PATH", and with cl.exe but no INCLUDE it fails on crtdefs.h -> corecrt.h not found.
environment.fix: A project-local CUDA 12.4.131 nvcc plus cudart was unpacked from NVIDIA redistributable archives into artifacts/local_checks/cuda12_toolkit/cuda12, and artifacts/local_checks/cuda12_toolkit/env.sh sets PATH, INCLUDE and LIB for the MSVC 14.44.35207 host toolchain and Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0. The system CUDA installation was not modified. PyCUDA's compile() defaults to nvcc="nvcc" and resolves it from PATH, so PATH is what redirects the compiler; CUDA_PATH alone does not.
environment.verification: The 12 m reference group reproduces the archived 2026-10-03 snapshot run bit for bit (max absolute difference 0.0), so the environment change did not alter any numerical result.

defect_found_and_fixed_during_the_batch.what: The first two G4 runs wrote snapshots of 660 cells while the solver ran 1320.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_the_batch.cause: The 7th to 9th parameters of #snapshot are the snapshot volume's own cell size. They were left at 0.05 while #dx_dy_dz declared dz = 0.025, and gprMax resolves the stored array shape from the snapshot line rather than from #domain.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_the_batch.detected_by: scripts/check_airlayer_boundary_batch.py compared the snapshot shape against the nx_ny_nz recorded in profile.h5 and flagged the magnetic time stamp, which was off by exactly half a coarse dt.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_the_batch.fix: prepare_airlayer_boundary_inputs.py now passes the refined dz into the snapshot line; the G4 input was regenerated and rerun from a cleaned directory.
defect_found_and_fixed_during_the_batch.lesson: Snapshot volume parameters are independent of #domain and must be kept consistent with #dx_dy_dz. A stale output directory is not the cause; the first rerun reproduced the same 660 cells.
